title: Improve terminal transcript and busy controls
context: TerminalScreen displays a bounded transcript but only clears it; while a command is running the input remains editable and the submit control does not show progress.
goal: Let users copy the visible terminal transcript in one action and make command execution state explicit while preventing input and clear actions during execution.
forbidden_changes: Do not change terminal command parsing, authorization, or runtime execution semantics.
Do not persist or transmit terminal transcript content.
Do not remove transcript line or byte bounds.
acceptance_criteria: Copy terminal output copies the currently visible transcript in order.
Copy action is disabled for an empty transcript and has an accessible localized label.
Input is disabled during command execution and a progress indicator replaces the submit icon.
Clear is disabled while executing and the existing transcript limits remain unchanged.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Review terminal controls and transcript-copy behavior
recovery: Revert the single task commit if the Apple build fails or terminal authorization/execution behavior changes.
